chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding
the man who performs Mut'a with the woman multiple times. He (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem; he may perform Mut'a with her for as many times as he desires.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem / it is permissible
key_terms.مَا شَاءَ: as much as he desires / whatever he wishes

ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the same woman multiple times via Mut'a in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that there is no limit to the number of times a man can contract temporary marriage (Mut'a) with the same woman, provided each instance constitutes a valid, independent contract. This ruling underscores the flexibility of Mut'a in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from permanent marriage by allowing repeated engagements without the need for a new divorce and re-marriage process. It highlights the practical application of the Prophet's tradition regarding the permissibility of multiple temporary contracts with a single partner.
